title: A self-injected proxied listener receives each published event once
summary: The self-injected proxied listener now receives one callback per event. Its advice and the independent listener observed identical event objects on both publications.

change.description: The event multicaster replaces a registered singleton target with its bean proxy when both represent the same listener. It makes the same choice for cached listener lists.

notes: The original package-scanned application, event publisher, eager listener and aspect come from the upstream test source. The repeated history adds an event-specific aspect and a separate listener.
